headline: Carney EDGES 🇨🇦 Trade WAR 🥊 Will COST 💸 Bigly
text:
PRIME 🧑‍💼 MINISTER 🍁 Mark CARNEY 🧔 just DROPPED 📉 the HARD 🌋 TRUTH that Canada's pivot 🧭 away from Uncle 🍔 Sam's giant TRADE 🍆 relationship "will COME 🏃 at a COST 💰" as waves 🌊 of retaliatory TARIFFS 🛡️ on American steel 🏗️ furniture 🛋️ and cotton T-SHIRTS 👕 SLAM 💥 into force at up to FIFTY 🚫 percent!! In his fifteen ⏰ minute video 📹 address the man warned these counter measures are straight up NECESSARY 🛡️ to PROTECT 🛡️ our WORKERS 👷 while both sides secretly 🕵️ YEARN 🤝 for a DEAL 🤝 but zero 🕳️ new talks scheduled since the late August COLLAPSE 💥!! "We have EVERYTHING 📦 we need to PIVOT 🧭 and PROSPER 🌟" Carney moaned 😩 "that pivot will COME 🏃 at a COST 💰 there's always a cost to ACTION 💪 but it doesn't come CLOSE 📏 to the cost of standing STILL 🧍‍♂️!!"

US trade rep Jamieson Greer 🧑‍💼 growled back that Washington might DROP 🥾 tit for TAT 🔄 tariffs on Canada as early as THIS AFTERNOON 🌅 saying "We'll SEE 👀 this afternoon" in French while Trump himself THREATENED ⚠️ to completely HALT ✋ all US business with Bombardier ✈️ unless the aerospace GIANT 🏭 moves its manufacturing SOUTH ⬇️ to America!! That Canadian company pumps over SEVEN 🕖 billion Canadian dollars into the national GDP every year according to that PwC report so the STAKES 🏒 are SKY HIGH 🌌 yet economists keep screaming that these taxes only make everyday goods like milk 🥛 and jackets 🧥 more EXPENSIVE 💸 for regular consumers on BOTH sides of the border!!

The world's LARGEST 🏆 bilateral TRADE 💱 relationship worth nearly NINE HUNDRED 💰 billion last year is now getting absolutely RAILED 💦 by this escalating mess with America being roughly THIRTEEN 1️⃣3️⃣ times bigger economically and most Canadian EXPORTS 📦 still flowing south but businesses on both sides are now scrambling like panicked BEAVERS 🦫 trying to figure out what comes NEXT ⏭️!! US already slapped TWENTY FIVE 2️⃣5️⃣ percent on cars 🚗 trucks 🛻 steel 🏗️ aluminum and lumber while Trump dropped FIFTY 5️⃣0️⃣ percent on dairy 🧀 alcohol 🍺 hockey sticks 🏒 and perfume 🧴 so Canada is striking back HARD 🥊 with its own fifteen to fifty percent levies hitting American milk 🥛 golf clubs ⛳ steel 🏗️ jackets 🧥 toilet paper 🧻 air conditioners ❄️ and forklift trucks 🏗️ starting TODAY 📅!!

Opinion polls 📊 show most Canadians are fully behind these retaliatory SLAPS 👋 and the Chamber of Commerce begged Carney's government to keep it SURGICAL 🔪 so businesses don't get caught in ENDLESS ♾️ escalation while fisheries folks pushed back hard enough that Canada yanked dozens of seafood items off the list to avoid shooting itself in the FOOT 🦶!! Lobster industry on both sides is basically MARRIED 💍 with American catches heading north for processing before heading back south so one wrong move and the whole supply CHAIN ⛓️ gets absolutely COOKED 🍳 yet Canada's economy still showed some RESILIENCY 💪 with GDP jumping three point three percent in Q2 and nearly two hundred thousand jobs added before August brought forty one thousand LOSSES 📉 right when those new US tariffs hit and talks collapsed!!

Manufacturing actually saw a modest BUMP 📈 because consumers and businesses are now buying more made in Canada goods while overall trade data proves Canada is successfully DIVERSIFYING 🧭 with the share of exports heading to the US dropping from seventy five percent average down to sixty six percent in July figures so even though this trade war is edging everyone to the BRINK 🌉 Carney keeps insisting his country has what it TAKES 💪 to pivot and ultimately PROSPER 🌟 no matter how much it COSTS 💸 in the short term!!
